$comment: Appendix A - Customer deliverables checklist, Playbook v5. Derived from the master schedule: if a task changes there, change it here. dueWeek in weeks before go-live; dueLabel overrides display. Conditions use the same language as tasks.json.

items.text: Practice legal name, DBA, EIN, Group NPI, taxonomy, specialties
All service locations with address, POS code, phone, fax, hours
CLIA number and certificate type per site, if applicable
Practice logo, letterhead, patient-facing display name
Provider roster: legal name, NPI, DEA + expiry, licence + expiry, taxonomy, PTAN, CAQH
Provider cell phone and direct email for every prescriber
Provider schedule templates and site rotation
Full staff list with names, emails, roles, site assignment
Named super user for each site
Sample de-identified notes, three to five per provider
Current visit type list with durations and scheduling rules
In-office procedure list with CPT codes
Current superbill / CPT and ICD-10 preference lists
.phrases / macro library export, if available
Reference lab account numbers for interface setup
Customer Service Record from the current fax carrier
Signed LOA, recent carrier bill, account number, PIN, exact service address
Confirmation of which numbers port and which are retained
Bank account owner name and email so the Sola application can be sent
POS terminal count per location and confirmation of pricing
Sola application completed and submitted directly to Sola
Confirmation of which prescribers require EPCS and which schedules
Two named administrators for EPCS logical access control
Prescriber-agent relationships and preferred pharmacies
Each provider personally completes ePx identity proofing
Full payer list where credentialed, with effective dates
Provider-level credentialing status including anything pending
Medicare PTAN and Medicaid ID per provider and location
Signed payer EDI enrollment forms and agreements
Outside billing company contact, BAA, scope of work, user list
Contracted fee schedules and allowed amounts
Self-pay, sliding scale and statement / collections policy
Twelve months of baseline reports — denials, A/R aging, payer mix, volume
Legacy vendor export confirmation, cost and notice period
Export format specification and sample file
Confirmed test export date and production export date
Test export delivered
Validation and written sign-off on the test migration
Decision on legacy read-only access duration and who pays
Production export delivered so data is available Friday
Triage protocols, phone scripts and nurse guidelines
Scheduling rules, new patient policy and provider preferences
Hours, holiday calendar, after-hours and on-call policy per site
Message routing rules, escalation criteria and contacts
Walk-in, cancellation, no-show and late-arrival policies
Protected training time blocked and staff coverage arranged
Reduced first-week schedule confirmed
Legacy address book export — referring providers, pharmacies, labs, imaging
Written confirmation of legacy access end date, terms and cost
Confirmation of where denials arrive today and who works them
Legacy payer table export for variant collapse and re-mapping
